continuity_links: The page directly follows an earlier injury event involving cetacyborgs and their acids.
The threat of pursuit by the Shabda-Oud clan drives the shift from battle to escape planning.

dialogue_meaning: The narration explains that cetacyborg digestive acids have corroded the first Metabaron's lungs.
Those around him are alarmed by his coughing, fever, and visible blood.
He tries to downplay his condition and insists he will recover soon.
He believes the immediate danger is the approaching Shabda-Oud clan.
He argues that survival now requires escape and concealment rather than continued battle.
His child disagrees and frames retreat as abandonment of the fight by the Castakas.

lore_facts: Cetacyborg intestinal acids are corrosive enough to destroy or badly damage lungs.
The first Metabaron resides in or returns to a place called a maxi-protonic tower.
The Shabda-Oud clan is a hostile force whose arrival creates urgent danger.
There exists a prepared refuge or escape installation called a metabunker.
The Castakas are identified as a family or group expected to take part in the fighting.
plot_events: The first Metabaron returns to his maxi-protonic tower while badly injured from exposure to cetacyborg acids.
He suffers repeated coughing fits and appears feverish and physically weakened.
A companion observes that he is coughing blood and that his lungs are damaged.
Despite this, he claims the problem is only a ruptured blood vessel in his throat.
He warns that the entire Shabda-Oud clan will soon arrive.
He says a metabunker is ready and proposes fleeing to live on a forgotten planet where no one will look for them.
A younger family member objects, saying the Castakas should rejoin the fight rather than hide.
uncertainties: The exact identity and names of the woman and the younger figure are not stated clearly on this page.
One dialogue balloon appears to say 'Catakas' or 'Castakas'; the lettering is small, but it clearly names the family/group the younger figure belongs to.
The distant background figures are too small to identify.
visual_summary: A narration box states that the first Metabaron has returned to his tower while suffering severe respiratory damage from cetacyborg intestinal acids. He is shown doubled over in a coughing fit on a biomechanical platform as family members rush to him. In closer panels, a woman supports him and points out his fever and blood-coughing, while he insists he will recover and urges haste because the Shabda-Oud clan is coming. A wide exterior shot shows a stark futuristic complex with a tall spire, identified in dialogue as a metabunker. In the final panel, the wounded Metabaron minimizes his condition and orders immediate flight from the planet, while a younger figure protests that the Castakas should stay and fight.
